name: Changchun Engley Automobile Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Changchun Engley Automobile Industry Co.,Ltd. research, develops, and manufactures automobile parts in China. The company offers metal products, including dashboard frames, crash beams, door sills, EV battery lower housings, EV battery upper housings, subframes, front and rear longitudinal beams, and other stamped body parts; non-metal parts, such as front-end frames, underbody protection plates, new energy battery lower protection plates, spare tire compartments, EV battery upper housings, battery trays, wheel covers, and front storage compartments, as well as produces molds. It also offers manufacturing and related technical consulting services. Changchun Engley Automobile Industry Co.,Ltd…
